scenarioSurface.capabilityName: Deliver capsule estate operations through one portable command carrier
scenarioSurface.scenarioName: Bind command fields without changing operation meaning

input.text: a command carrier containing only the declared repository root, query, capability identity, capability input, target root, disposable parent root, capability identities, or fixture identities needed by that command

outcome.text: verify, resolve, list, inspect, invoke, expand, project, direct proof, capsule-first proof, and sterile proof receive only their capsule-estate-operation-request.v2 fields and test and direct are aliases of prove-direct-execution

scenarioSurface.notes:
Developers and agents use one stable JSON command surface while capsule
  meaning remains owned by operate-capsule-estate. The delivery capability owns
  only command and standard-stream carriers, canonical operation-request
  construction, projected capability invocation, result rendering, and exact
  usage failures.

  Every request carries its caller-authorized repository root explicitly. No
  checkout path, scratch root, tool root, or machine identity is embedded in
  feature, blueprint, capability, capsule, or bootstrap authority. Commands
  requiring structured values receive JSON carriers rather than relying on
  unadmitted text splitting.

schema.title: canonical-circuit-blueprint.v1
schema.description: Normalized carrier for one capability's canonical circuit blueprint. Structural authority only: it constrains shape, closed vocabularies, and locally decidable field applicability. Graph-wide obligations - acyclicity outside declared bounded returns, complete branch variant coverage, jointly required fan-out membership, complete convergence requirement sets, monotonic advancement, and observability sufficiency - are owned by inspect-canonical-circuit-blueprint-candidate and prove-canonical-blueprint-geometry, not by this schema.

disposition.description: Projection never upgrades a CANDIDATE carrier to ADMITTED.

structuralMapping.$comment: Governed C4 mappings to structural realization authority.

code.$comment: Optional and always projected; never authored as structural authority.

projectionAuthorities.$comment: Profiles and views this blueprint permits. A projector may not emit a profile absent from this list.

semanticIdentity.description: Stable kebab-case semantic identity, optionally version-suffixed. Never a filesystem path or generated symbol.

projectionOrdinal.description: Deterministic display order for otherwise independent peers. Presentation authority only; carries no execution or precedence meaning.

altitude.description: CAPABILITY uses the scenario cell (Input/Event/Outcome). Lower altitudes retain the three-position protocol with their own semantic nouns and never acquire the promised experience.

cell.$comment: The three-position protocol. Position nouns differ by altitude; the geometry does not.

variants.$comment: Declared Outcome variants. Decisionality is owned here, never by an inserted decision node.

requiredProducts.$comment: Complete set of upstream products a convergence node's Input contract demands. Jointly required, never alternatives.

allOf.$comment: A junction is an Outcome that declares more than one variant.

edge.$comment: Edge semantics are orthogonal. Topology, contract relation, semantic progress, and selecting variant answer different questions and are never collapsed into one relation enum.

contractRelation.description: How a product and an Input contract compose. Applicable only to contract edges.

semanticProgress.description: How meaning advances. Required for every executable forward transition and governed return.

selectingVariant.description: The exact declared Outcome variant that selects this edge.

semanticPrecedence.description: REQUIRED imposes partial order. INDEPENDENT marks peers that need no arbitrary total order; their display order comes from projectionOrdinal alone.

boundedReturn.$comment: A back edge is legitimate only with declared bounded repair, resumption, or iteration authority and an explicit bound.

fanOutSetId.$comment: Members sharing a fanOutSetId are jointly required; all must close.

allOf.$comment: A branch route names the exact variant that selected it.
Selecting variant is forbidden where no variant selects the edge.
Executable forward transitions must declare how meaning advances.
A convergence requirement is a contract edge, not an executable transition.
An altitude descent is the only topology that changes altitude.
A back edge without declared bounded authority is rejected.
Fan-out membership is meaningless without its jointly required set.

observabilityContract.$comment: Every executable cell binds its testimony before physical telemetry realization.

sliDefinition.$comment: An SLI is constructed only from exact admitted testimony identities. An incidental implementation metric is not an indicator.

missingTestimonyDisposition.description: A partial evaluation window is never a satisfied production promise.

childAllocations.$comment: Governed allocation profiles only. A child budget is never inferred from topology or observations.

slaBoundary.$comment: External service obligations bind only at declared boundaries. Contractual leakage into unbound internal mechanics is rejected.
